title: Is Nintendo Switch Online still worth it in 2026? - Engadget
summary: The Nintendo Classics library is worth poking around, plenty of Switch games offer enjoyable online play, and the Nintendo Music app is fun if you want something different — it even works with Android Auto and CarPlay .
